dspark_drafter_note.observation: The 0731 GGUF repo ships its own DSpark drafter files at the repo root and under dspark/: 'dspark-DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731-Q8_0.gguf' (10896057440 bytes) and 'dspark/dspark-DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731-BF16.gguf' (11314832480 bytes). This differs from the v0.4.2 production drafter pin (configs/pins/ds4-weights.json role=dspark_drafter), which came from the separate third-party repo bleysg/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark-drafter-GGUF at Q2K-Q8 quantization. The bleysg drafter file does NOT apply to 0731 (different base model weights it must stay token-distribution-compatible with); the 0731 built-in Q8_0 drafter is the closest analog but has never been staged, hashed, or speed-tested against this deployment's DSpark profile. This is flagged as an open item in the requalification plan (scripts/96_requalify_dsv4_0731.md) and is NOT staged or downloaded by this task (out of scope: base UD-Q2_K_XL only, per task instructions).
